node.statement: Choose e_co as the minimum of e_0, the thresholds in lem-compcb-amplified-compression, lem-compcb-amplified-compression-identities, and lem-compcb-rectangular-product, and 1; choose C_co=K_a+C_p*(M+K_u). Nodes 1.2-1.4.1 and the triangle inequality then give both root bounds. All constants and e_co are universal and independent of n, calA, T,R,A; by lem-compcb-amplified-compression, u_{T,n}=Co_{T_n}(T_n)=I_n tensor Co_T(T) and similarly for R, so this is exactly the root notation.
